$comment: Curated. Maps every extracted component to one canonical component. `canonical` names come from the accepted vocabulary.md. test/component-map.test.mjs fails when an extracted component is unmapped.

components.note: Native select in all three stacks. Searchable and remote modes belong to Combobox.

components.rename: Modal → Dialog across all stacks, matching the pilot issue and the native element.

components.note: Livewire has no DropdownItem; items are Menu components placed inside the dropdown.
Different mounting models: Livewire renders one component and is driven by a window event plus the Toast trait; React and Vue use a provider and a hook/composable.

components.consolidation: Choices + ChoicesOffline → Combobox with `searchable` and `remote` modes.
Candidate to become a Combobox `multiple` + `allowCustom` mode; it already shares the searchable option API.
Candidate for Select with an option-group shape rather than a separate component.
Candidate for a DatePicker `time` mode; the issue tracks both together.

components.rename: Radio → RadioGroup, since every stack's Radio is an options-driven group.
components.consolidation: `radio` and `radio-group` overlap almost entirely (only `inline` vs `horizontal` differ). `group` is the same options API rendered as a joined button group, which becomes a `variant`.

components.note: Vue exports FileUpload because File shadows the browser global; React has the same shadowing problem. Pick one name for all stacks.

components.rename: errors → validation-summary, so it is not confused with ErrorState.
components.note: Reads Laravel's error bag. Not the same thing as React/Vue ErrorDisplay.

components.livewireOnlyCandidate: Named in #8. Canvas-based, so porting is small; the question is demand.

components.note: Same purpose, different engines: Livewire embeds TinyMCE with uploads; React and Vue use a bare contentEditable. These are not at feature parity even though all stacks 'have' it.
components.livewireOnlyCandidate: Named in #8. Only the TinyMCE engine is Livewire-only; React and Vue already ship a lighter editor, so this is an engine decision rather than a parity gap.

components.rename: Editor → CodeEditor. The same word means TinyMCE in Livewire and a monospace textarea here.
components.note: Not in any wave issue. Could also become a Textarea `monospace` option and be dropped as a component.

components.structure: Livewire is compositional (five components); React and Vue are data-driven (`items`).
components.consolidation: Menu* are one family, with composition as the base; see vocabulary.md, 'Data-driven vs compositional'.

components.structure: Livewire is compositional (`tab` children); React and Vue are data-driven (`tabs`).
Livewire is compositional (`step` children); React and Vue are data-driven (`steps`).

components.rename: header → page-header. It is a titled section header, not a site header.
main → app-shell; Sidebar is a part of it.
components.note: Livewire `main` composes sidebar + content + footer. React and Vue only have the sidebar piece, with no page frame.
Livewire's version carries a `progress` loading bar and `target`; the other stacks are a plain rule.
WidgetGrid is a columned dashboard grid. Treated as the same primitive; the wave issue lists only the Livewire name.
Not in any wave issue. Decide whether layout primitives stay in the system now that Tailwind is optional.

components.rename: profile → user-menu. It is an avatar dropdown, not a profile page.
components.consolidation: Candidate to become an Avatar + DropdownMenu recipe in the docs rather than a component.

components.note: Livewire has no component: 5 components carry tooltip props and apply raw DaisyUI classes. New first-class component per #59.

components.livewireOnlyCandidate: Built on wire:stream. React and Vue would need a different transport.

components.note: Not in any wave issue. Add to Feedback.
Not in any wave issue, though the component-usage rules already recommend it to Livewire users. Add to Feedback.
Not in any wave issue. Add to Feedback.

components.consolidation: Overlaps Stat (`change`, `sparklineData`). Candidate for a Stat `surface`/layout option.

components.structure: Livewire has only the item, composed by hand; React and Vue are data-driven (`items`).

components.consolidation: Overlaps Carousel. Candidate for a Carousel image mode.

components.livewireOnlyCandidate: Named in #8. Tied to Livewire file uploads and the WithMediaSync trait.

components.note: Livewire's is a full Livewire component; event-modal-content is its internal child, not public API.

components.livewireOnlyCandidate: A theming dev tool rather than a UI component; may move to the docs-site theme builder (open question 5).

components.note: Not in any wave issue. Add to Utility.
